name: 柔白触感-新拟物
type: Rounded humanist Chinese sans-serif, medium weight, gently rounded numerals; never thin low-contrast grey.
material: AUTHENTIC NEUMORPHISM: all main surfaces are the SAME cool silver-white material as the canvas, sculpted rather than white cards pasted on grey. Convex extruded pads have paired white upper-left and cool grey lower-right soft shadows; the search and mode track are visibly debossed concave wells. Consistent upper-left light source. Tactile 18-28 logical px corners, embossed simple line icons. Deep blue-grey text and restrained slate-blue selected controls. No glass/transparency, no hard borders, no hard offset shadows. Emphasize tactile topography, not ordinary rounded SaaS cards.
